# Teller Performance and Customer Wait Time Standard Update

This document addresses the urgent need to update and investigate teller performance standards. 

Key actions required:

*   Update the teller performance standard.
*   Investigate teller performance urgently.
*   Review the teller performance standard update.
*   Investigate customer wait time based on audit findings.
